meta.name: Senna
meta.description: Fascinated by cars since childhood, Brazilian racer Ayrton Senna became a sports legend — until tragedy struck, changing Formula 1 forever.

videos.title: Calling
videos.overview: Ayrton Senna begins his racing career in Formula Ford. Far from home and dreaming big, he craves recognition and more opportunities on the track.

videos.title: Belonging
videos.overview: After catching Peter Warr's eye, Senna makes a decisive career move. A trip to Italy elevates his car's performance. Alain Prost and Senna cross paths.

videos.title: Ambition
videos.overview: Galvão discusses Senna's duty to Brazil. A karaoke night opens doors. Ayrton's rivalry with Prost intensifies before the 1988 World Championship.

videos.title: Passion
videos.overview: Senna's romance with Xuxa sparks a media frenzy. A broken engine, public conflicts and on-track drama escalate the tensions between Senna and Prost.

videos.title: Hero
videos.overview: After Senna's controversial press conference, Balestre announces the season's drivers. Prost leaves McLaren, and Senna makes a desperate move to win.

videos.title: Time
videos.overview: Senna makes a pivotal career move. As friends suffer track accidents, he pushes for increased safety measures before his fateful race at Imola.
